messages.subject: Farringdon Quarterly – office take-up rebounds, Elizabeth Line effect continues
messages.plaintextBody:
This issue: Clerkenwell and Farringdon office take-up rose 11% in Q1 as occupiers chase well-connected buildings near the Elizabeth Line; prime yields hold around 5.5%; and a look at the public realm works on Farringdon Road. Plus: refurbishment vs redevelopment in EC1.
